dataset.available_participants_policy: Execute only independently admitted available participants; unavailable participants unknown, never losses; no unused-budget redistribution.
dataset.hash_definition: SHA-256 of compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON containing payload_files [{name,sha256}] in samples,fixtures,oracles order and case_hashes [{id,sha256}] in JSONL order. Each payload_sha256 hashes compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of that record without newline. case_sha256 hashes {id,payload_sha256}. No self-referential commitment hash.
dataset.task_budgets: UNSET; retain original protocol, calibrate on development evidence and seal separately before any final execution.
dataset.models_and_provider_policy: unchanged from candidate freeze; no fallback or new provider authorization

protection.disclosure: Only public structure and hashes; participant sees current authorized input/fixture surface, never oracle or full event schedule.
protection.retention: Evaluator-owned retention through comparison and owner review; explicit controlled-access/cleanup moment still must be bound before execution per original protocol.

samples.jsonl.compatibility: native Inspect Sample-compatible JSONL; no custom result format
samples.jsonl.input: string ordinary-language user input; voice requires actual audio ingress, not text fallback

oracles.jsonl.coverage_tags: array[string]; evaluator-only, not a public per-case hint

structural_validation.unseen_scope: Independently authored after freeze; no use of known C01/C04/CONT01/RT-001 as final cases. Does not prove absence from arbitrary model training data.

remaining_bindings: Per-family task and aggregate budgets and execution order calibrated on development evidence, sealed before final calls.
Individually admitted native participants with equal tools/data/network/hardware and full accounting/stop coverage for the relevant family.
Existing Inspect input loading plus thin semantic/readback scorers bound to private oracle records; no fixture-oracle success may be relabelled as native quality.
Local fixture service/browser origins, controlled clock/background events, identity/audience guards, process interruption and independent native memory/effect/file readback adapters.

Exact synthetic speech/non-speech audio waveforms and delivery conditions must be recorded and hash-bound by independent operators; native microphone/playback and duplex route required. Text cannot substitute.
Two independent blinded human raters for the protocol human judgements; physical listening remains required where specified, never inferred from transport success.
Explicit private evidence retention, controlled rater access and cleanup moment before execution.
